proposals.rule: Short UI command labels, such as buttons, links, toggles and setting labels, use the 2nd-person singular imperative (e.g. "Shrani", "Posodobi", "Omogoči", "Obnovi podatke"). This is the standard Slovenian form for commands and does not break the formal register. Do not flag it as informal, and do not suggest the plural form ("Obnovite", "Shranite"). The same applies when prose quotes a button's label: the quote must match the actual label, e.g. "Obnovi podatke" (link_sharing_toggle_title, backup-file-moz-browser-restore-step-2-1, Onboarding…AgreementButtonTitle). What still counts as a defect: full sentences and instructions addressed to the user in prose, such as descriptions, messages and help text, must use the formal (vikanje) form. A quoted label that doesn't match the real string's wording is also still an error.
